open_items_for_orchestrator.description: Phase 6 / T6.1 disposition (Posture A vs Posture B for ~20+ planning-side agent doc_type emission edits). Plan v2 default is Posture A (defer). Deferred-edits state is a Scope-Deviation per ADR-0033. Without these edits, the next post-ratification feature run will trigger validator failures at Gate 0 for every artifact those agents author. USER DECISION REQUIRED AT GATE 6.
open_items_for_orchestrator.disposition: USER DECISION REQUIRED at Gate 6 final approval. DAG preserves both postures explicitly per ADR-0029 + ADR-0033 no-silent-absorption. Per the orchestrator's instructions to this decomposer, the DAG does NOT silently absorb the Posture-A scope deviation.

open_items_for_orchestrator.description: PV-0 through PV-6 are the gate contracts; their pass criteria are specified in phase-validators.md and assertable per the Plan's Exit Criteria. Per the bootstrapping discipline, PV-0 (and PV-1, PV-2) are user-verified at phase boundaries until T3.4 lands and can be invoked retroactively / for subsequent runs.
